## Hermes digest – hf-models
08:10 Europe/Athens.

Hugging Face API: the 50 trending text-generation models and the 50 trending GGUF models. Keeps models created today or yesterday (Athens) that are GGUF or have more than 100 downloads; image, audio and video models are skipped. Template only, no LLM. Nothing new = no message.

Nothing is delivered anywhere (the Nextcloud Talk delivery was removed): every run returns the composed message in its execution result, and another workflow can call this one with {"dry_run": false|true, "use_llm": false, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Credentials are created by n8n/scripts/hermes-digests-setup.sh.
